question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Interpreter of Maladies’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhumpa Lahiri**__.

__
 
• **Jhumpa Lahiri is the author of the book ‘Interpreter of Maladies’**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Interpreter of Maladies**

 
 
• It is a book collection of nine short stories.
 
• The stories are about the lives of Indians and Indian Americans who are caught between their roots and the "New World".
 
• It was published in 1999.
 
• Jhumpa Lahiri won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction and the Hemingway Foundation/PEN Award in the year 2000 for this book.
 
 
 
• **Jhumpa Lahiri**
 
 
• She is an Indian-origin American author.
 
• She has been a professor of creative writing at Princeton University since 2015.
 
• Other books/novels written by her- The Namesake, The Lowland, Whereabouts, The Clothing of Books, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Books/Novels by **Sudha Murty**- Mahashweta, Dollar Bahu, The Old Man and his God, etc.
 
• Books/Novels by **Anita Nair**- Cut like Wound, Malabar mind, Mistress, etc.
 
• Books/Novels by **Arundhati Roy**- The God of small things, My Seditious heart, The Ministry of Utmost Happiness, etc.
